properties.description: 14 cases over review_relations and unreviewed_ideas. The boundary they exist to pin is that 'nobody looked' and 'somebody looked and there was honestly nothing' are DIFFERENT STATES — including that a blank note is not an answer, that one bad link writes none of them, that being related TO counts as connected, and that a detector with nothing to run on says nothing rather than reporting '0 of 0'.
properties.name: A review records one of exactly three states, and refuses to record none
